claims.text: Workspace provider record DOI `10.1112/jlms.12832` has abstract field: “We prove the minimality conjecture. Our proof uses the Hopf algebra structure of the ring of symmetric functions.” [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 124-131]

groundings.excerpt:
124: \begin{abstract}
125: A minimal presentation of the cohomology ring of the flag manifold $GL_n/B$ was given in [A.~Borel, 1953]. This presentation was extended
126: by [E.~Akyildiz--A.~Lascoux--P.~Pragacz, 1992] to a non-minimal one for all Schubert varieties. Work of [V.~Gasharov--V.~Reiner, 2002] gave a short, \emph{i.e.} polynomial-size,
127: presentation for a subclass of Schubert varieties that includes the smooth ones. In [V.~Reiner--A.~Woo--A.~Yong, 2011], a general shortening was found; it implies an exponential upper bound of $2^n$ on the number of generators required. That work states
128: a minimality
129: conjecture whose significance would be an exponential lower bound of $\frac{\sqrt{2}^{n+2}}{\sqrt{\pi n}}$ on the number
130: of generators needed in worst case, giving the first obstructions to short presentations. We prove the minimality conjecture. Our proof uses the Hopf algebra structure of the ring of symmetric functions.
131: \end{abstract}
